correctness.rationale: The weighted composition map W_t has triangular coefficient entries t^n 1_{j≤n}. It is trace class for 0<t<1 by a product of two Hilbert–Schmidt factors. K=W_tW_t^* has Gram kernel t^{n+m}(min(n,m)+1). Every principal minor factorizes into increasing-index gaps; summation over independent positive gaps gives e_k=t^{k(k−1)}/prod_{j≤k}(1−t^{2j})², establishing the entire Fredholm determinant and its Hahn–Exton third-Jackson normalization termwise. The adjoint has zero kernel and the second-difference recurrence determines each positive eigenvector uniquely from its first scalar, proving infinitely many simple positive eigenvalues and positive simple determinant zeros.
